source_text:
10.6 Πῦρ καὶ θεῖον καὶ πνεῦμα καται γίδος, ἡ
μέρις τοῦ ποτηρίου αὐτῶν. Ποτήριον νῦν τὴν κόλασιν ὀνομάζει, ἐν ῳ κακίας καὶ
ἀγνωσίας ἐγκέκραται πόμα.
pass_a_gloss: Fire and brimstone and wind of-storm, the portion of-the cup of-them. Cup now the punishment he-names, in which of-vice and of-ignorance has-been-mixed a-drink.
pass_b_english: “Fire and brimstone and a storm-wind, the portion of their cup” (Psalm 10:6).
Cup now names punishment, in which a drink of vice and ignorance has been mixed.

choices.why: ποτήριον is the cup of wrath as κόλασις, mixed of vice and ignorance. Not a eucharistic cup.

anf_compare.notes: ANF lacks this Greek catena as reading English.
